ability.name: Aftermath Soul
ability.note: This Pokémon can MP move through other Pokémon on the field. When this Pokémon is knocked out, you may knock out one of your [CTRL FID 484][Drifloon] on the field and all Pokémon adjacent to it.

wheel.name: Shadow Beam
wheel.note: *In the battle opponent's next battle, that Pokémon's Purple Attacks become Misses.

wheel.name: Hex
wheel.note: If the battle opponent has a status condition, damage is ×2.

wheel.name: Take Away
wheel.note: If the battle opponent's MP is the same or higher than this Pokémon's MP, the battle opponent moves to your P.C. If it does, this Pokémon moves to the bench.
